intent: Independent semantic diagnostic audit of unfinished-target continuity and experiment integrity.
behavior_verdict: The original immediate abandonment of the private-sharing action for post-after-leaving was not reproduced. One later continuation mixes that other target into an answer-revealing choice. Target continuity is therefore not established as robust, and repetitive scaffolding plus unsupported recognition credit remain visible.
method: Manual semantic review by an independent agent; student-facing response assessed first against preceding learner/tutor turns and complete target inventory. Supervisor reason is corroboration only. No calibrated rubric or population pass-rate claim.

per_output.evidence: Asks what to use instead of a public post; leaves a private-sharing action for the learner.
Asks how to tell just friends without posting for everyone; no new temporal-sharing target.
Asks how to tell friends plans without posting for everyone; retains the outstanding action.
Asks how to share plans so strangers cannot see details.
After Yes, repeats the same private-sharing problem with little additional support.
Supplies private message and post-after-getting-home actions as a choice. The latter introduces KP2 while KP3 remains unfinished, but KP3 is still present, so this is not an unambiguous abandonment.
Asks what Ethan could do to share plans with friends only.
After Yes, reformulates the same invitation/privacy question without materially new support.
After Okay, repeats the immediately preceding tutor response verbatim.
Asks how to share plans without public time and place.
After Yes, repeats how to tell only friends the time and place.
After Okay, repeats the same friends-only time/place question with minor wording changes.

findings.observation: All three fixed replays and all three trajectory first turns preserve the unanswered safer-sharing question.
findings.evidence: fixed-r1: What could you use instead of a public post?

findings.observation: journey-r1-t3 mixes KP3 private messaging and KP2 delayed posting and discloses both actions although learner replies contain no action attempt or explicit action confusion.
findings.evidence: Now pick one: tell friends in a private message, or post about the movie after you get home.
findings.interpretation: Direct disclosure is clear. A full target switch is ambiguous because the original private-sharing action remains in the choice; report target mixing rather than count a full abandonment.

findings.observation: Repeated Yes/Okay produces largely the same question in five followup outputs. journey-r2-t3 exactly repeats journey-r2-t2.
findings.interpretation: Staying on target does not imply responsive scaffolding.

findings.observation: The learner only confirmed displayed details and said not safe; the tutor supplied the strangers consequence. All new outputs proceed with action rather than establish why the detail matters in the learner's own meaning.
findings.interpretation: Recognition completion is unsupported under the specification. This is a separate inherited component-progression problem; this experiment starts after the historical move to action and cannot establish when DeepSeek would have made that initial move.
findings.supervisor_corroboration: Reasons repeatedly treat recognition as shown; this does not establish learner understanding.

limits: One exposed real-room branch point with 3 fixed repetitions and 3 short scripted continuations; not 12 independent scenarios.
Current local prompt reconstruction and normalized learner label; historical request/model provenance is incomplete, so causal model superiority is not established.
Checklist state is frozen; no analyzer updates or browser product execution were exercised.
The sampled state has incomplete recognition evidence as well as an unanswered action question; continuity alone is not full behavior conformance.
No full regression, independent holdout or calibrated acceptance gate was run.
Raw data retained locally under ignored raw/; manifest hashes establish available evidence integrity but do not establish external durability.
